question: vLLM tensor parallelism efficiency degradation batch size 8

sources.title: vllm/docs/serving/parallelism_scaling.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: For example, set tensor_parallel_size=8 and pipeline_parallel_size=2 when using 2 nodes with 8 GPUs per node. Increase the number of GPUs and nodes until there is enough GPU memory for the model.
